source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: جدي كان دايما يقول: عنا كنز بالبيت.
sentences.en: My grandfather always used to say: we have a treasure in the house.

sentences.ar: إحنا الولاد، كنا ندور عليه بكل زاوية.
sentences.en: We kids used to search for it in every corner.
We searched the cabinets, under the beds, and in the attic.

sentences.ar: بس ما لقينا لا ذهب ولا مصاري.
sentences.en: But we found neither gold nor money.

sentences.ar: سألنا جدي: وين الكنز؟ ما لقيناه.
sentences.en: We asked our grandfather: where is the treasure? We didn't find it.

sentences.ar: ضحك جدي وقال: الكنز مش شي بتلاقوه بإيدكم.
sentences.en: My grandfather laughed and said: the treasure isn't something you find with your hands.
We grew up, and each of us went their own way.

sentences.ar: بس كل عيد، كنا نرجع نجتمع ببيت جدي.
sentences.en: But every holiday, we would come back to gather at grandpa's house.

sentences.ar: كنا نقعد حوالي الطاولة، ونحكي ونضحك.
sentences.en: We would sit around the table, talking and laughing.

sentences.ar: جدي كان ينظر إلنا، وعيونه مليانة فرح.
sentences.en: My grandfather would look at us, his eyes full of joy.

sentences.ar: يوم، قبل ما يتوفى، جمعنا كلنا حواليه.
sentences.en: One day, before he passed away, he gathered us all around him.

sentences.ar: قال: هلأ فهمتوا شو هو الكنز؟
sentences.en: He said: now do you understand what the treasure is?

sentences.ar: نظر لوجوهنا، وقال: إنتوا الكنز، عيلتي.
sentences.en: He looked at our faces, and said: you are the treasure, my family.
We all fell silent, and felt the meaning of his words.

sentences.ar: من يومها، عرفنا إنه أغلى كنز هو الأهل.
sentences.en: From that day, we knew that the most precious treasure is family.
